channel.title: Games: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the games sector.

item.title: Dragonfly GF: Dragonfly GF's trading suspension period changed after delisting grounds arose, now lasting until the objection period expires or the delisting decision is made.
DoubleUGames: DoubleU Games reported Q3 2026 standalone revenue of KRW 41.7bn, down 3.6% YoY, with a net loss of KRW 5.3bn.
NHN: NHN reported 3Q26 standalone revenue of KRW 102.9bn and operating profit of KRW 22.2bn, up 10.4% and 28.7% year on year.
